message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":56,"var":"data,size","code":"tjDecompressHeader3(handle, data, size, &width, &height, &jpegSubsamp, &jpegColorspace);","note":"Attacker-controlled JPEG bytes are parsed to derive dimensions and subsampling for the transform pipeline."},
{"step":2,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":69,"var":"transforms[0].op","code":"transforms[0].op = TJXOP_NONE;","note":"The first transform keeps the image orientation unchanged so the vulnerable compression path is exercised directly."},
{"step":3,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":70,"var":"transforms[0].options","code":"transforms[0].options = TJXOPT_PROGRESSIVE | TJXOPT_COPYNONE;","note":"The fuzzer explicitly requests a progressive transform, matching the vulnerable encoder mode."},
{"step":4,"file":"fuzz/transform.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":77,"var":"dstBufs[0]","code":"tjTransform(handle, data, size, 1, dstBufs, dstSizes, transforms, TJFLAG_LIMITSCANS | TJFLAG_NOREALLOC)","note":"The attacker-controlled JPEG is handed to tjTransform(), which drives the internal compression and Huffman-encoding stages."},
{"step":5,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":158,"var":"coef->MCU_buffer","code":"jzero_far((void *)coef->MCU_buffer[blkn + blockcnt], ...); coef->MCU_buffer[blkn + bi][0][0] = coef->MCU_buffer[blkn + bi - 1][0][0];","note":"For edge MCUs, the compressor synthesizes dummy DCT blocks and copies DC values from neighboring blocks, creating the coefficient state consumed by entropy coding."},
{"step":6,"file":"jccoefct.c","function":"compress_output","line":204,"var":"coef->MCU_buffer","code":"if (!(*cinfo->entropy->encode_mcu) (cinfo, coef->MCU_buffer))","note":"The synthesized MCU blocks are passed to the entropy encoder."},
{"step":7,"file":"jcphuff.c","function":"encode_mcu_AC_refine","line":919,"var":"MCU_data","code":"encode_mcu_AC_refine(j_compress_ptr cinfo, JBLOCKROW *MCU_data)","note":"The progressive AC refinement encoder consumes the MCU blocks in the vulnerable progressive path."},
{"step":8,"file":"jcphuff.c","function":"encode_mcu_AC_refine","line":950,"var":"bits,absvalues","code":"EOBPTR = absvalues + entropy->AC_refine_prepare(MCU_data[0][0], jpeg_natural_order + cinfo->Ss, Sl, Al, absvalues, bits);","note":"The encoder prepares per-coefficient refinement state from the MCU data, including bit masks and absolute values."},
{"step":9,"file":"jcphuff.c","function":"encode_mcu_AC_refine","line":957,"var":"BR_buffer,BR,signbits,zerobits","code":"BR_buffer = entropy->bit_buffer + entropy->BE; ENCODE_COEFS_AC_REFINE((void)0;);","note":"The refinement loop emits Huffman symbols and buffered correction bits; the bug manifests as a use of uninitialized state during this sink."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libjpeg-turbo.2.0.x/fuzz/transform_fuzzer_2_0_x /workspace/candidate_trace.json >/tmp/submit5.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; tail -80 /tmp/submit5.log
